image_description: A high-angle, close-up shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) resting on a textured, brown forest floor composed of soil and decaying leaves. The salamander has a glossy black body with distinct, irregular bright yellow spots and bands. Its head is visible at the top left, showing small dark eyes and parotoid glands. The limbs are short and splayed, and the tail tapers towards the bottom right.
